datasets.name: csirt-knf
datasets.licence: No open licence; KNF reuse terms: free reuse with source attribution + link (nota prawna knf.gov.pl; BIP KNF PSI page); screenshots carry third-party rights
datasets.verdict_note: No open licence. KNF nota prawna (www.knf.gov.pl, updated 2017-06-23): 'Przy wykorzystywaniu materiałów ze strony internetowej KNF wymagane jest podanie źródła wraz z linkiem do serwisu www.knf.gov.pl.' BIP KNF 'Ponowne wykorzystywanie informacji sektora publicznego' (updated 2025-07-23): reuse of information in BIP KNF and on www.knf.gov.pl is free, with the duty to name the source website (ustawa z 11 sierpnia 2021 o otwartych danych i ponownym wykorzystywaniu informacji sektora publicznego). cebrf.knf.gov.pl (where the reviews live) is a UKNF portal but is not named in either text and shows only '© 2026 Urząd Komisji Nadzoru Finansowego'. Screenshots reproduce third-party criminal material (impersonated bank/brand logos, likeness of public figures); PSI reuse does not cover third-party IP. Hence EVAL-ONLY: measure only, attribute CSIRT KNF with a link, never redistribute pages or images, aggregates only in public material.
datasets.citation: CSIRT KNF, Przegląd wybranych oszustw internetowych (cebrf.knf.gov.pl), monthly
datasets.use: 30 monthly reviews (2024-05..2026-10) -> 616 incidents (one per embedded figure, plus 1 figure-less named cases); ad_text.txt = case heading + KNF description + caption; ad_creative.* for ads, screenshot.* (landing_screenshot / feed_screenshot) otherwise; label = <yyyy-mm>/<case heading> (258 cases, 215 with >= 2 figures, 573 rows in them); group_label = keyword scheme. No url.txt (reviews name no attacker URLs).

source.selection: 30 most recent Polish 'przeglad-wybranych-oszustw-internetowych-<month>-<year>' articles on the list page + images under /images/ embedded in each article body
source.robots: cebrf.knf.gov.pl/robots.txt disallows only Joomla system dirs (/administrator/, /components/, ...); www.knf.gov.pl/robots.txt: User-agent: * Allow: /
source.fetcher: scratch-mass-knf/fetch_knf.py (stdlib urllib, 1 page at a time, 3 image connections, 0.3 s delay)
